evidence_items.locator: Section “Stress testing the limits of agent teams,” subsection “Evaluation”
evidence_items.explanation: Carlini's public account identifies Claude Code sessions, provides source code, and expresses surprise at the achievement. The reported compiler functionality goes substantially beyond a small app or website, although the account also discloses dependencies, defects and extensive human work on the testing environment.

evidence_items.locator: Opening discussion, before “Looking Inside the Claude C Compiler”
evidence_items.explanation: Lattner reports examining the public source history and praises the coherent engineering system. He also finds familiar LLVM/GCC-derived designs, weak generalization and a toy code generator; those qualifications support parts of Zitron's concern but do not make the entire project a toy app or website.

unresolved_gaps: The evidence does not establish exactly which compiler sources were present in Anthropic's training data.
The independent review is a source-code examination, not a complete independent reproduction of every advertised compiler result.
